deterministicGateOrder: required artifacts and official-source records exist
five-step field topology and visibility classes are complete
private essays are no more than 300 words
protected contact values are absent from the committed guide
current opportunity and resume selection passes
only then may modeled-reader calls be queued

civic-match-helper.passStatement: I would confidently surface this candidate to a government hiring partner for at least one current target role.
civic-match-helper.authorityBoundary: A Civic Match helper may recommend or surface; this is not the government employer's hiring decision.

opportunity-hiring-reader.passStatement: I want to interview this candidate for this role and see a credible path to hiring them.
opportunity-hiring-reader.authorityBoundary: The reader receives no Work for America-only essay, protected contact field, local file, source code, private evidence, or prior judge output.

desiredSignal: I want to hire this person for one of the current opportunities for which I am responsible.
